title: Private revision-bound UI human-gate session and validated final event
rules: A session file is private, mode 0600, revision-bound, bounded, and contains no prompt or transcript.
Rendering is an input projection and never constitutes approval.
Approve, reject, clarify, timeout, and cancellation require one validated final event and human presence for human choices.
The final event is single-use and bound to the exact request, input event, session, and task revision.
Coordinator persistence is idempotent and is not claimed by an offline checker.

failure_semantics.persistence: one idempotency key; not performed offline

limitations: The fixture is synthetic structural evidence only.
No live UI, Coordinator, network, provider, or durable state operation is performed.
A validated event is not task completion or authority approval until Coordinator consumes it.
